description: Check one organization against OFAC (SDN), UK OFSI, UN Security Council and World Bank debarment lists. Returns match / possible_match / no_match with a link to the register entry behind each hit. Free without an API key: 3 checks per hour. With an x-api-key: 10 credits ($0.10) per check. Country is accepted for future use and is not yet applied as a filter.

country.description: Optional ISO alpha-2 country code, e.g. GB. Not yet applied as a filter.

name.description: Organization name exactly as it appears on a contract or invoice.
